name: 12094-widebatchdecode-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
architecture: Dense LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, 32 query / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 4096, bf16, ~8.03B params (~15.0 GB); KV = 128 KiB per token.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=1024, bounded at 20480 requests / 1800 s safety, warmup the first 25% by completion.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, `request_format: plain` (no chat template), fixed lengths: prompt exactly 64 tokens, output exactly 256 tokens (min = max, `ignore_eos`), temperature 1.0 / top_p 1.0 -- all written in scenario.json.
purpose: A high-volume story continuation service for an 8B model, streaming 256-token completions from short prompts across 1024 simultaneous users on one GPU.
launch:
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
enable-prefix-caching: false
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 2048
